name: hyperodds
description: Live data on Hyperliquid HIP-4 outcome markets from every deployer: books, fair lines with their sources, rule comparisons and the newest listings.
long_description:
Ask Claude about any HIP-4 outcome market on Hyperliquid. Hyperodds answers with the live book, a fair line and where it comes from, the edge after every fee, and whether other deployers listing the same question settle it by the same rules.

Try:

- Which HIP-4 markets show the biggest edge after fees right now?
- Where do the fair lines on the BTC markets come from, and how confident are they?
- What was listed in the last hour?

Every tool is read-only: none can trade or access an account. There is nothing to sign up for. The extension forwards each request to the hosted Hyperodds server at api.usehyperodds.com, which allows 1,000 tool calls a day per IP address.

tools.name: odds_markets
tools.description: HIP-4 markets from every deployer with the book, fair line, edge after fees, 24-hour volume and event time. Filter by category, deployer or text and sort by edge, volume, new or settling.

tools.name: odds_cluster
tools.description: One question listed by several deployers: each listing's rule grade (SAME, CLOSE or DIFFERENT), the differences found and the merged book.

tools.name: odds_fair
tools.description: One market's fair line: probability and band, method, confidence, each source with its weight and age, and the edge after fees for each way to trade.

tools.name: odds_new
tools.description: The newest HIP-4 listings first, with the same fields as odds_markets.
